iris-glow.$description: Iris Glow — Violet accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ember-red.$description: Ember Red — Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

coral-pulse.$description: Coral Pulse — Gradient start and secondary accent — used sparingly on warm cards and the pink-orange wash

sunset-amber.$description: Sunset Amber — Gradient end — the warm terminal of the coral-to-orange wash used on featured cards

ink.$description: Ink — Headings, strong borders, icon fills — the heaviest text weight and the sharpest structural lines

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary body text and the workhorse border color — appears more than any other color, forming the connective tissue of the layout

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary headings and muted borders

cool-gray.$description: Cool Gray — Body and helper text where lower contrast is acceptable

steel.$description: Steel — Subtle text and quiet borders

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary text and disabled-leaning borders

pearl.$description: Pearl — Hairline borders, icon containers, and link outlines that need to recede

mist.$description: Mist — Soft surface tints and the lightest structural dividers

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces and elevated content — sits one step above the page canvas

linen.$description: Linen — Page canvas and the base of the surface stack

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary surface for nested elements and subtle backgrounds

cream.$description: Cream — Warm accent card surface — the only place the system breaks from cool neutrals

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Active and hover wash — the soft halo behind selected links and cards

rose-glow.$description: Rose Glow — Tinted shadow color for warm cards — a blush offset shadow that ties to the coral accent

maison-neue.$description: Primary body and UI text. Weight 400 for running copy, 600 for emphasis. The 40px size anchors the manifesto headlines. Substitutes: Inter, Söhne, General Sans

graphik.$description: Links, buttons, card titles, and section headings. The workhorse for anything interactive or navigational. Substitutes: Inter, Untitled Sans, Söhne

neue-montreal.$description: Micro-labels, tags, metadata, and tracked-out captions. The wide tracking at small sizes is the signature move — it makes 8–12px text feel like printed stationery, not UI chrome. Substitutes: Neue Haas Grotesk, Inter Tight, Monument Grotesk

sf-pro-display.$description: System font fallback for native-feeling status bar text and a few embedded contexts. Rarely the primary face.

chirp.$description: Twitter embed text — appears only inside embedded tweet widgets, never used for first-party content

bluu-suuperstar.$description: Display/decorative accent — used at most three times on the page for a single moment of personality. The 38px size is the signature flourish.
